newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's IBGE raises grains/oilseeds estimate.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's IBGE raises grains/oilseeds estimate.

text.p: Brazilian 1997 production of grains and oilseeds could reach 77.20 million tonnes, up from a previous forecast of 76.40 million tonnes, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in a statement.
The most recent estimate is also 5.39 percent higher than the 73.25 million tonnes produced in 1996, it added.
Soybean production is now seen reaching 25.77 million tonnes, slightly up from a forecast issued in June of 25.59 million and 9.75 percent higher than last year.
Output from the first corn harvest should total 29.82 million tonnes, up from a previous forecast of 29.65 million tonnes and 7.34 percent more than in 1996, the IBGE said.
The second corn crop is forecast at around four million tonnes, up 10.14 percent from last year.

Even with the risk of losses due to lack of rains at this time of the year, production is increasing annually, demonstrating the heightened interest on the part of producers in this crop, the IBGE said,
